title: Add erp-sim inbound delivery service
description: Implement A_InbDeliveryHeader/A_InbDeliveryItem reads, PATCH of ActualDeliveryQuantity with ETag, and function imports PostGoodsReceipt and putaway functions in services/erp-sim/src/erp_sim/services/inbound.py. Material documents numbered 4900000000+, mvt 101 per item.
done_when: Sim posts GR for SAMPLE delivery 180000123 and returns a material document in range; delivery OverallGoodsMovementStatus becomes C. FR3.010 FR3.043

title: Add Alembic migrations for Phase 3 tables
description: Create field_0030–field_0039: task_line warehouse columns, handling_unit extensions, count_record, pi_document, posting_job ordering columns, site graph tables, anchor, trail_point, approval_request. All with tenant_id and forced RLS.
done_when: Upgrade and downgrade run clean on an empty and a seeded database; RLS policy test passes for each table. FR3.065

title: Add erp-sim outbound delivery service
description: Implement A_OutbDeliveryHeader/Item reads, PickOneItem, ConfirmPickingOneItem, PostGoodsIssue (601) and ReverseGoodsIssue (602) in services/erp-sim/src/erp_sim/services/outbound.py with enqueue lock per delivery.
done_when: SAMPLE delivery 800000045 can be picked, issued and reversed; lock conflict returns 423 while another session holds it. FR3.023 FR3.024 FR3.043

title: Add erp-sim physical inventory service
description: Implement A_PhysInventoryDocHeader/Item create and read, count entry by PATCH, InitiateRecount and PostDifferences (701 gain, 702 loss) with freeze snapshot and posting block flags in services/erp-sim/src/erp_sim/services/physinv.py. Numbering 100000000+.
done_when: PI doc with freeze snapshots book qty at creation; PostDifferences posts against the snapshot and returns a material document. FR3.035 FR3.037 FR3.043

title: Add erp-sim material document service
description: Implement A_MaterialDocumentHeader/Item read, Cancel and CancelItem (102/602 reversal semantics), and creation of 321 transfers in services/erp-sim/src/erp_sim/services/matdoc.py. Reversal of an already reversed item returns 409.
done_when: Cancel of a 101 document creates a 102 document referencing it; stock per material/plant/stock type nets to zero. FR3.011 FR3.015 PR3.01

title: Write declarative SAP mapping files
description: Author connectors/sap/mappings/{inbound_delivery,outbound_delivery,physinv,material_document}.yaml mapping field entities to OData entity sets, properties, function imports, units and conversions; each row carries verification status VERIFIED or UNVERIFIED.
done_when: JSON Schema validation passes; mapping docs table generated into docs/SPEC/F2_SAP_MAPPING.md. FR3.042

title: Implement adapter warehouse calls
description: Implement connectors/sap/src/sap_adapter/warehouse.py: CSRF token fetch, sap-client header, If-Match on PATCH, function import calls, SAP message parsing into retryable/non-retryable classes, and pre-post probes via document flow.
done_when: Golden-payload tests produce byte-identical requests for SAMPLE commands; error classifier unit tests pass. FR3.044 FR3.041

title: Build the parity contract suite
description: Write compat/sap_parity/ tests that run the same command scripts against erp-sim and against recorded SAP fixtures (VCR cassettes) and compare normalised observable state.
done_when: Suite green on sim; fixture runs skip with UNVERIFIED reason when cassettes absent. FR3.043 PR3.15

title: Add sim fault injection profiles for warehouse
description: Extend erp-sim fault profiles with warehouse_lock (423 30%), timeout_after_commit (5%), validation_400 and latency_p95_2s; selectable by header X-Sim-Fault-Profile in non-production only.
done_when: Chaos tests can select each profile; production build rejects the header. FR3.043 FR3.040

title: Implement ordered posting queue claim
description: In services/field-worker/src/field_worker/posting/queue.py claim the lowest-seq pending job per queue_key using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED plus pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(tenant_id||queue_key)); later jobs wait until predecessors are posted or cancelled.
done_when: PR3.07 passes; two workers never process the same queue_key concurrently (TC3.131). FR3.038 FR3.039 PR3.07

title: Implement retry classification and backoff
description: Apply backoff 2/4/8/16/32 s (cap 32) with ±10% jitter, max 8 attempts; retry on network, 5xx, 423 and SAP enqueue lock messages; fail fast on 4xx validation; on final failure emit erp.failed and open an exception case.
done_when: PR3.13 passes; TC3.132 shows attempts at expected offsets. FR3.040 PR3.13

title: Implement idempotency and pre-post probe
description: Store one idempotency key per erp_document (unique), send it as compact 23-char header text F+base64url(uuid), and before any retry probe SAP for an existing document (document flow or header text) and adopt it if found.
done_when: PR3.06 passes; TC3.133 shows no duplicate after timeout-after-commit. FR3.041 PR3.06

title: Expose posting queue APIs
description: Add GET /v1/posting-queues, GET /v1/posting-queues/{queue_key}/jobs, POST /v1/posting-jobs/{id}/retry and POST /v1/posting-jobs/{id}/cancel with field.queue.manage permission and audit.
done_when: Schemathesis passes; cancel re-evaluates later jobs per BR3.14. FR3.045

title: Emit posting events through the outbox
description: Write posting.requested, erp.posted, erp.failed and erp.reversed with warehouse payloads (queue_key, seq, doc_type, movement types, items) to the outbox in the same transaction as state changes.
done_when: Event payloads validate against EV3.01–EV3.04 schemas; no event without committed state. FR3.038 FR3.064

title: Add posting metrics and alerts
description: Export field_posting_latency_seconds, field_posting_attempts_total, field_queue_blocked_seconds and alert when any queue is blocked > 300 s or success within 5 min < 99.5% over 1 h.
done_when: Alerts fire in the chaos run and clear after recovery. FR3.040

title: Import inbound deliveries into receive tasks
description: Poll A_InbDeliveryHeader/Item every FIELD_IBD_POLL_S for the site's plants and storage locations, upsert by DeliveryDocument and LastChangeDateTime, and create one receive task per delivery with one task_line per item.
done_when: TC3.101 and TC3.103 pass; re-import creates no duplicates. FR3.001 FR3.003

title: Add CSV inbound delivery import with guided-load conventions
description: Add console upload of an SAP delivery export CSV with column mapping, material matching ladder (auto-accept >= 0.95 with no rival within 0.05, else review) and preview before creating tasks.
done_when: TC3.102 passes with SAMPLE CSV of 40 lines; ambiguous matches land in review. FR3.002

title: Validate SSCC captures for receiving
description: On capture.created with code_type sscc, validate 18 digits and GS1 mod-10 check digit, reject duplicates within the delivery (unique index tenant_id, delivery_ref, sscc), and attach the HU to the matching task_line.
done_when: PR3.12 passes; duplicate returns 409 FIELD-RCV-409-SSCC-DUPLICATE with MSG3.03. FR3.004 PR3.12

title: Derive HU quantity and counted quantity
description: Set HU qty from GS1 AI 37 or AI 30 when present, else material units per carton, else request a voice count; compute line counted qty as sum of non-discarded captures unless a voice override exists.
done_when: PR3.02 passes; TC3.105 passes. FR3.005 FR3.006 PR3.02

title: Apply over and under delivery rules
description: Evaluate counted vs expected with the PO tolerances cached on task_line; block confirm above tolerance and open an exception case; require reason code below expected and record late-receipt candidates.
done_when: PR3.14 passes; TC3.106, TC3.107 pass. FR3.007 FR3.008 PR3.14

title: Handle damaged cartons
description: Implement 'mark damaged' on the last capture: require crop evidence, exclude from unrestricted GR, then reject or post to blocked stock per site setting (D3.01).
done_when: TC3.108 passes for both settings. FR3.009

title: Stage and post goods receipt
description: On confirm create erp_document (doc_type GR, mvt 101), build PATCH ActualDeliveryQuantity per item plus PostGoodsReceipt jobs in queue IBD:<delivery> in confirm order.
done_when: TC3.109 passes; material document number in 4900000000–4999999999 recorded. FR3.010

title: Implement undo after post as reversal
description: Map 'undo' after posting to a reversal erp_document (102) using CancelItem for a line or Cancel for the whole document; original stays posted with status reversed after success.
done_when: PR3.01 passes; TC3.110 passes. FR3.011 PR3.01

title: Route quality-hold receipts
description: When material.qm_inspection is true or a site hold rule matches supplier+material, post GR to quality inspection stock and direct putaway to bins in zones with hold=true; add release with 321 by field.quality.release.
done_when: TC3.111 passes. FR3.012 FR3.015

title: Generate putaway tasks with bin proposal
description: After GR posted create one putaway line per HU; propose fixed bin, else nearest empty allowed bin by graph distance; reserve the bin for 30 min.
done_when: Proposal deterministic for SAMPLE layout; reserved bins not proposed twice. FR3.013

title: Confirm putaway by bin scan
description: Accept bin label QR or barcode; matching bin confirms; other bin requires 'confirm' plus reason and checks capacity and hold zone rules; call putaway functions only for sites with putaway_in_erp=true (D3.04).
done_when: TC3.112 passes. FR3.013 FR3.014

title: Record dock-to-stock timestamps
description: Store dock_arrived_at (task start or first capture), gr_posted_at and putaway_confirmed_at per HU; expose to the receiving dashboard.
done_when: TC3.113 passes on fixture with known durations. FR3.016

title: Add receive task APIs
description: Implement API3.01, API3.04–API3.08 for receiving and putaway with Idempotency-Key, ETag and problem+json codes FIELD-RCV-*.
done_when: Schemathesis contract run passes with zero schema violations. FR3.061 FR3.065

title: Import outbound deliveries into pick tasks
description: Poll A_OutbDeliveryHeader/Item with OverallPickingStatus not C; create one pick task per delivery; sort lines by route order from the site graph.
done_when: TC3.114 passes. FR3.017 FR3.026

title: Confirm picks by capture
description: Require source bin scan then product capture (GTIN DataMatrix or HU SSCC); reject wrong material; enforce batch AI 10 and serial AI 21 when material is batch or serial managed.

title: Handle short picks
description: Accept 'count n' below required with reason bin_empty, damaged or not_found; open a short-pick exception and create a cycle-count request for the source bin.
done_when: TC3.117 passes. FR3.020 FR3.028

title: Post picking quantities
description: Queue PickOneItem and ConfirmPickingOneItem jobs per line in OBD:<delivery> in confirm order.
done_when: TC3.118 passes. FR3.021

title: Pack picked lines into outbound HUs
description: Generate SSCC from tenant GS1 company prefix (SAMPLE 0890123), extension digit and serial reference with check digit, or accept a pre-printed SSCC scan; packed qty per line <= picked qty; render PDF label.
done_when: TC3.119 passes; PR3.12 covers generated SSCCs. FR3.022

title: Post goods issue and reversal
description: Allow PostGoodsIssue (601) only when all lines picked or short-confirmed and packed where required; GI qty = picked qty; reversal 602 via ReverseGoodsIssue on undo after post or supervisor action.
done_when: PR3.08 passes; TC3.120 passes. FR3.023 FR3.024 FR3.025

title: Optimise pick path order
description: Order stops by graph shortest-path distances using nearest neighbour followed by 2-opt for <= 40 stops; fall back to bin name order if graph unpublished.
done_when: Route length <= bin-order length on 100 SAMPLE pick lists. FR3.026

title: Create PI documents from planner requests
description: Implement POST /v1/pi-documents and console form (plant, storage location, bins or materials, planned count date, freeze, posting block); create in ERP via queue PID:<doc>/<year>.
done_when: TC3.121 passes. FR3.027

title: Implement cycle-count rules
description: Add cycle_count_rule config (ABC frequency SAMPLE A 30 d, B 90 d, C 180 d; triggers short_pick, putaway_mismatch); daily job at 02:00 site local groups due items into PI requests of <= FIELD_PI_MAX_ITEMS.
done_when: TC3.122 passes. FR3.028

title: Enforce blind count projection
description: Define OperatorCountLine schema without book fields; operator routes, websocket topics and lens payloads use it; only field.pi.book.read sees book qty in console after the count is committed.
done_when: PR3.03 passes; TC3.123 scanner finds no book qty in any operator response. FR3.029

title: Implement count entry and commit
description: Count line qty from captures or 'count n'; 'count zero' sets zero flag; commit only on 'confirm'; one count_record per counter per count number.
done_when: TC3.124 passes; PR3.02 covers count lines. FR3.030

title: Evaluate variance and recount rules
description: After commit compute difference vs book snapshot; require recount when |diff|/book > FIELD_PI_RECOUNT_PCT or |diff value| > FIELD_PI_RECOUNT_VALUE; assign recount to a different operator; accept recount within ±max(1 unit, 0.5%) else third count by inventory controller.
done_when: PR3.04 passes; TC3.125, TC3.126 pass. FR3.031 FR3.032 FR3.033

title: Assign and claim recounts
description: Add POST /v1/pi-documents/{id}/items/{item}/recount-assignment and the claim check on count submission: the recount operator must differ from every earlier counter of the item; console suggests eligible operators on shift at the site.
done_when: PR3.04 passes; same-operator claim returns 409 FIELD-PI-409-RECOUNT-SAME-OPERATOR. FR3.032

title: Apply freeze book inventory semantics
description: Store book snapshot at PI creation when freeze=true; compute differences vs snapshot; show 'Movements since freeze: n' when material movements occurred after snapshot.
done_when: PR3.16 passes; TC3.128 passes. FR3.035

title: Enforce posting block
description: While a PI doc has posting block, refuse putaway and pick confirmations for affected bin/material pairs with FIELD-PI-423-POSTING-BLOCKED and MSG3.15.
done_when: TC3.129 passes. FR3.036

title: Implement field-local approval interim
description: Create approval_request with band from the mirrored core band table (P13d bundle export), SoD check (approver not a counter, not the requester), approver re-authentication via core SSO max_age=300; adapter interface ready for the Phase 5 seam.
done_when: PR3.05 passes; TC3.127 and TC3.155 pass. FR3.034

title: Post counts and differences
description: Queue count PATCH then PostDifferences (701 gain, 702 loss) in PID queue; difference posting waits for approval when value > FIELD_PI_APPROVAL_VALUE.
done_when: TC3.130 passes. FR3.034 FR3.037

title: Import storage bins into the location tree
description: Import SAP storage bins (CSV or OData read where available) and parse with a per-site regex (SAMPLE ^(?<aisle>\d{2})-(?<rack>\d{2})-(?<level>\d{2})$) into zone>aisle>rack>level>position; reject cycles; report unparsed bins.
done_when: PR3.11 passes; TC3.137 passes. FR3.046

title: Generate the default site graph
description: Create way nodes per aisle segment, place nodes per bin face, walk edges along aisles, road edges in forklift lanes and climb edges for mezzanine stairs; lengths from coordinates.
done_when: Generated graph is connected for SAMPLE site; every bin has one place node. FR3.047

title: Build the console graph editor
description: Canvas editor for nodes, edges, kinds, landmarks ('look for' cues), forklift zones and anchors with validation and versioned draft/publish in apps/field-console/app/sites/[id]/graph/.
done_when: TC3.138 passes; publish blocked while validation errors exist. FR3.047 FR3.048

title: Register anchors
description: Add anchor CRUD: QR labels carry anchor id and HMAC-SHA256 tag (key per site in vault), BLE iBeacon UUID/major/minor, UWB anchor id; each bound to a node and x/y/z.
done_when: TC3.139 passes; forged tag rejected. FR3.048

title: Implement positioning fusion on Android
description: In apps/field-android/core/positioning implement a constant-velocity 2D Kalman filter fusing QR fixes, UWB ranges, BLE RSSI fixes, step-detection dead reckoning and ARCore VIO when the phone is held; snap to nearest edge within 2 m.
done_when: PR3.17 passes; TC3.140 median error <= 1.0 m with UWB. FR3.049

title: Implement route API and step builder
description: Dijkstra with climb weight ×3 and road edges excluded for pedestrian profile; build steps with distances, turns and 'look for' cues; re-route when off-route > 4 m for 5 s.
done_when: PR3.09 passes; TC3.141 passes. FR3.050

title: Implement walking-quiet mode
description: Suppress lens and audio prompts and disable capture when in a forklift zone and speed > FIELD_WQ_SPEED_MPS for 1 s; queue prompts and release after 1.5 s stationary; show only 'Walking. Prompts paused.'
done_when: PR3.10 passes; TC3.142 passes. FR3.052

title: Build 2D and 3D wayfinding views
description: Phone 2D SVG map with route line and position dot; 3D extruded racks with SceneView (D3.05); lens shows next step and distance only.
done_when: TC3.141 usability pass rate >= 90%. FR3.051

title: Record trails
description: Record trail_point at 1 Hz only while a task is active, upload in batches via POST /v1/trails, retain 30 days, supervisor access with field.trail.read, operator sees own.
done_when: TC3.143 passes. FR3.053

title: Publish graph versions to devices
description: On publish emit graph.published; devices download the version (gzip JSON, ETag) and keep the last two versions for offline routing.
done_when: Device switches to new version within 60 s of publish when online. FR3.047 FR3.062

title: Build the live task board
description: Console page with columns open, in progress, blocked, awaiting posting, done; cards show task type, delivery/doc, operator, progress; updates via live topic taskboard.{site_id}.
done_when: TC3.144: update visible <= 2 s p95 with 200 active operators. FR3.054

title: Build the discrepancy queue
description: List warehouse exception cases (over, under, damaged, short pick, SSCC duplicate, variance, recount, approval pending, posting failed) with decide actions gated by permissions and audited.
done_when: TC3.106 and TC3.136 pass. FR3.055

title: Build the receiving dashboard
description: Show dock-to-stock p50/p90 by day, open deliveries, deliveries past planned date, GR posting latency; CSV export.
done_when: TC3.145 numbers match fixture. FR3.056

title: Build the inventory accuracy KPI
description: Compute accuracy (items within tolerance / items counted) and value accuracy (1 - sum|diff value| / sum book value) per site per week; trend chart.
done_when: TC3.145 values match fixture. FR3.057

title: Build PI documents, approvals and posting queue pages
description: Console pages for PI documents (status, counts, recounts), approval decisions with re-authentication, and posting queues with retry now and cancel.

description: Daily 01:00 site local and on demand, write field_supply_<site>_<yyyymmdd>.csv with stable row_key per field record; console download; mapping documented in docs/runbooks/core-guided-load.md.
done_when: PR3.18 passes; TC3.146 loads in core-p13 compat. FR3.058 FR3.060

title: Detect late receipts

done_when: TC3.147 passes. FR3.059

title: Implement lens screens for warehouse tasks

title: Implement phone screens for warehouse tasks
description: Compose phone screens SCR3.02, SCR3.05, SCR3.07 with line lists, reason pickers, pack view and wayfinding; offline banners and outbox counts.
